title: Imbaga y'abantu Bazimiye
intro: Uhagaze imbere y'amajwi y'umuryango inkuru yawo yanditswe mu miraba. Abo bantu bumvise umuhamagaro, bahitamo kwigomeka, maze bahura n'ingaruka zahinduye isi. Ni bande, kandi se isi yabo yabaye iki?
clues: Twabayeho kera cyane, maze intumwa idusanga iturutse hagati yacu.
Twasengaga ibigirwamana bitanu kandi twanze kubireka.
Twamusabye ko yaguha igihano niba ari umunyakuri.
Twabonye ijuru rigwa imvura, isi ivubura amasoko.
Twazamutse tujya ahantu hirengeye kugira ngo duhunge, ariko imiraba iraturenze.

outcome.answer: Twese twarazimiye uretse abizera bari kumwe na Nuh

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
